rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3" bh_python_install --install --root "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3"
# The wheel itself goes into python3-pip-whl: ensurepip, and so python3 -m # venv, installs pip from there. The folder has to be the one python3.14 is # built with (--with-wheel-pkg-dir). WHEEL_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/wheel/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/python-wheels"
install -d -m 0755 "$WHEEL_DIR" install -m 0644 dist/pip-*-py3-none-any.whl "$WHEEL_DIR/"
